dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Pronounced symmetric geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel distribution across the visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, low-contrast diagonal linear striations across the mid-dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Elongated vertical shadow/lineation along the central posterior axis indicative of the dorsal ridge structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, healed linear marks/scars on the mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, high-contrast transverse crescent-shaped blowhole at the anterior extremity.
